name: DuraHUD
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Renterq
description: Durability, potion count and effect timers on your HUD. Three separate displays with multiple styles, your own color bands, and full control over position — client-side only.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Durability HUD: at the top left (gui 4,4) a row per damaged armour piece and the held item, with its icon, percent left and a coloured bar; plus an effect timer list (top right) and a potion counter (bottom right).
note: Not yet: its settings screen (key K) doesn't open; the effect list's replacing of the vanilla effect icons (replaceElement) does nothing under Kiln
